title: AgentProfile
description: Declarative Agent Profile: the unit every other pillar operates on (EPIC-00, issue #4; issue #9). Declares id, version, owner, the pinned system-prompt reference, the closed tool allowlist, constraint set, capability set, default model tier, memory scope, and the bound guardrail policy. The vocabulary enums in definitions are the CLOSED platform vocabulary: an unknown tool/capability/constraint/guardrail reference is rejected by the schema itself, and registry/profiles/validate.py additionally enforces fail-closed membership against registry/profiles/catalog.yaml (with a schema<->catalog parity gate). Seed profiles live under registry/profiles/seeds/; immutable published snapshots are recorded in registry/profiles/versions/manifest.yaml. See registry/profiles/README.md (the contract doc).

id.description: Stable profile id (lowercase, dash-separated, e.g. orchestrator, data-agent). Must equal the seed filename stem. Later lanes (registry service, persona mapping) address agents by this id.

version.description: SemVer version of THIS profile (X.Y.Z). A published (id, version) is immutable: once recorded in versions/manifest.yaml, editing the file that carries it is refused by the validator (sha256 mismatch).

owner.description: Accountable owner of the profile lifecycle, expressed as namespace/team (e.g. platform/quality). Identity/RBAC (phase 6) consumes this as a principal/team reference.

systemPromptRef.description: Pinned reference to a versioned prompt module in the prompt library (phase 1 issue #13), format <module>/<name>@v<n> (e.g. coder/primary@v1). Mirrors the harvested gmail-agent prompts/<task>/v1.ts convention. Resolution is owned by the prompt-library lane; this schema pins the reference shape only.

toolAllowlist.description: Closed allowlist of tool ids this profile may invoke. Any tool not in the platform tool catalog is rejected (fail closed). The catalog (catalog.yaml) is the extensible registry; unknown ids are refused until the registry lane adds them.

constraintSet.description: Boundary constraints (deny/require rules) this profile operates under, drawn from the closed constraint catalog (catalog.yaml). Enforced by the guardrails pillar at runtime.

capabilitySet.description: Closed set of capabilities this profile may exercise (hermes capability-registry pattern: {"code-gen": true, ...}). Any capability not in the catalog is rejected (fail closed); the registry/gateway routes only declared capabilities.

defaultModelTier.description: Default dispatch tier on the flash/pro ladder (LOW/MED -> flash, HIGH/MAX -> pro; CMR docs/MODEL-PROFILES.md). Model routing (phase 2) consumes this.

memoryScope.description: Memory scopes this profile may read/write (vscode-memory MemoryType pattern: repository/session/user). At least one scope is required.

guardrailPolicyRef.description: Single reference to the guardrail policy (atomic or bundle id from the guardrail-policy catalog) bound to this profile. Unknown policy ids are rejected (fail closed). Atomic ids name one policy; bundle ids expand to a policy list (catalog.yaml bundles).

role.description: Canonical CMR agent role this profile fills (CMR onboarding/agent-profiles/role.schema.json). Optional: a platform profile need not name a role, but when it does the id must exist in the canonical CMR role vocabulary. The registry/parity gate fails if the declared set drifts from CMR (issue #145).

model.description: Concrete worker model for the default tier (flash or pro). Separates the MODEL axis from the tier axis (leaderboard fleet-roster ROLE/TIER/MODEL/TRANSPORT/EFFORT separation). Optional.

transport.description: How the model is carried: a provider API (deepseek/api) or the running CLI session (session). Separates the TRANSPORT axis (leaderboard lib/fleet-roster.sh role_transport). Optional.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this profile's dispatches (low/medium/high; leaderboard lib/fleet-roster.sh role_effort). Separates the EFFORT axis. Optional.

capabilityTier.description: Capability tier (deep/balanced/fast; leaderboard fleet-roster three-tier routing) chosen from dispatch complexity, distinct from the semantic model tier. Optional.

fallbackChain.description: Ordered fallback chain of canonical role ids to dispatch when this profile cannot serve the task (capital-underwriting config/leaderboard/capability-registry.json 'fallback' pattern). Every id must be a canonical CMR role. Optional.

canonicalLanes.description: Canonical CMR lane ids this profile owns (CMR role schema ownedLanes). Optional cross-walk to the CMR lane taxonomy; distinct from a persona card's free-form ownedLanes.

weekly_spend_ceiling.description: First-class per-profile FinOps ceiling: the maximum the platform may spend on this profile in a rolling week, in USD. Optional; when absent the profile is governed by the platform default budget guardrail. When present it must be a non-negative number (a negative ceiling is refused by the schema and by registry/profiles/validate.py).

roleId.description: Canonical CMR agent-role vocabulary (CMR onboarding/agent-profiles/role.schema.json properties.role.enum), backfilled per issue #145. The registry/parity gate fails if this set drifts from the canonical CMR role set in either direction.

workerModel.description: Concrete worker model (CMR role schema model.model): flash = the volume tier, pro = the reasoning tier.

transport.description: Transport that carries the model (leaderboard lib/fleet-roster.sh role_transport): deepseek = the DeepSeek API path; api = the Anthropic API path; session = the running CLI session.

capabilityTier.description: Capability tier (leaderboard fleet-roster three-tier routing: deep/balanced/fast).

canonicalLane.description: Canonical CMR lane vocabulary (CMR role schema properties.ownedLanes.items.enum), backfilled per issue #145. The registry/parity gate fails on drift.

weeklySpendCeiling.description: Non-negative weekly spend ceiling in USD. Draft-07 treats booleans as a distinct type, so true/false fail here; registry/profiles/validate.py additionally refuses a negative or non-numeric value fail-closed.

toolId.description: Closed platform tool catalog. Keep in sync with catalog.yaml tools (validate.py parity gate enforces it).

capabilityId.description: Closed platform capability catalog. Keep in sync with catalog.yaml capabilities (validate.py parity gate enforces it).

constraintId.description: Closed platform constraint catalog. Keep in sync with catalog.yaml constraints (validate.py parity gate enforces it).

guardrailPolicyId.description: Closed guardrail-policy catalog: atomic policy ids plus named bundle ids (bundles expand to atomic policy lists in catalog.yaml). Keep in sync with catalog.yaml guardrailPolicies (validate.py parity gate enforces it).

modelTier.description: Dispatch tier on the flash/pro ladder (LOW/MED -> flash, HIGH/MAX -> pro).
